content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed from the prior submission:** the scope prong is no longer claimed as already met. The single replacement in p0492 now opens with operative language limiting the covenant to named compounds — "For purposes of Ono's obligations and Array's remedies under this Section 8.2, Competing Product means only a product, other than a Product, that includes Binimetinib or Encorafenib as an active pharmaceutical ingredient" — so Ono is no longer bound across an unascertainable redacted compound class. Tying the narrowed scope to Array's remedies as well prevents the retained "Array may immediately terminate" sentence from operating on a broader trigger than Ono's obligation.

**Retained in the same operation:** term-only limitation, twelve-month outer cap, internal research/Development carve-out, and acquisition/merger carve-out. All five fallback elements are now mapped to operation 1; minimality validated (ok:true), the only deletion remains the post-termination extension, and Array's reciprocal class-wide restriction, the royalty-termination consequence and the Article XIV cross-reference are untouched.
